support_functions.c_function: NOINLINE uint64_t fixture_leaf_u64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return (uint64_t)(a + b); }

cases.semantic_note: volatile loads occur before the call; dependent nonlinear folding uses each value afterward and prevents a simple reduction before the call
